dedupe_keys.name: french polynesia agricultural statistics bulletins bulletin statistique agricole direction de l agriculture 2010 to 2022

description: These annual bulletins are the official agricultural statistics of French Polynesia, published by its Direction de l'Agriculture. The statistics page links one bulletin a year for 2010 and from 2012 to 2022, the latest posted in May 2025, and sets them in the context of the territory's general agricultural census and its strategy of supporting family farming across the islands. All are free to download as PDFs. Caveats: the contents of individual bulletins were not opened here, so the exact tables are not listed; figures are in PDFs; the series runs two to three years behind; the pages are in French; and no licence is stated. Coverage is the territory as a whole. Simulation uses: local food production baselines for island supply disruption scenarios after cyclones or interruptions to shipping. Related records: the New Caledonia DAVAR statistics (data-davar-new-caledonia-agricultural-statistics) are a comparable Pacific island source.
